summary.en: Israeli AI company providing state-of-the-art large language models like Jurassic J2 series.
summary.zh: 以色列AI公司，提供先进的大语言模型，如Jurassic J2系列。

title.en: AI21 Labs API Key - Jurassic Large Language Models | Get Model Key
title.zh: AI21实验室 API Key - Jurassic大语言模型 | Get Model Key

description.en: Get AI21 Labs API key for access to Jurassic series large language models.
description.zh: 获取AI21实验室 API Key，访问Jurassic系列大语言模型。

en: AI21 Labs is an Israeli AI company known for its Jurassic language models, including Jurassic-J2 Ultra, Mid, and Fast for text generation and understanding workloads.
Teams use AI21 Studio when they want direct access to Jurassic APIs for drafting, rewriting, and enterprise text pipelines without routing through a third-party model host.
AI21 is an official model provider, not an aggregator. Get Model Key only links to studio.ai21.com and docs.ai21.com; we do not sell API keys or credits.
zh: AI21 Labs 是以色列 AI 公司，以 Jurassic 系列大语言模型著称，包括 Jurassic-J2 Ultra、Mid、Fast，面向文本生成与理解场景。
若需要直接调用 Jurassic API 做起草、改写或企业文本流水线，而不经过第三方模型托管，可使用 AI21 Studio。
AI21 是官方模型提供方，并非聚合平台。Get Model Key 仅跳转 studio.ai21.com 与 docs.ai21.com，不售卖 API Key 或额度。

en: Create or sign in to an AI21 Studio account at studio.ai21.com.
Open Account → API Key (studio.ai21.com/account/api-key) and generate a key.
Copy and store the key securely; treat it like a production secret.
Call AI21 endpoints with that key and follow request formats in docs.ai21.com.
zh: 在 studio.ai21.com 注册或登录 AI21 Studio 账号。
进入 Account → API Key（studio.ai21.com/account/api-key）并创建密钥。
立即复制并安全保存，按生产密钥标准保管。
使用该 Key 调用 AI21 接口，请求格式以 docs.ai21.com 为准。

question.en: Which models can I access with an AI21 API key?
question.zh: AI21 API Key 可以调用哪些模型？

answer.en: Keys from AI21 Studio unlock Jurassic models such as Jurassic-J2 Ultra, Mid, and Fast. Confirm the live catalog and parameters in official docs.
answer.zh: Studio 签发的 Key 可调用 Jurassic 系列（如 J2 Ultra、Mid、Fast）。具体型号与参数以官方文档为准。

question.en: Where is the official AI21 key page?
question.zh: AI21 官方 Key 页面在哪里？

answer.en: Manage keys at https://studio.ai21.com/account/api-key. Documentation lives at https://docs.ai21.com/.

question.en: Does Get Model Key sell AI21 keys?
question.zh: Get Model Key 会售卖 AI21 Key 吗？

answer.en: No. This site only links to AI21’s official Studio pages. Billing and key issuance happen on AI21.
answer.zh: 不会。本站只提供 AI21 官方 Studio 入口，开户、计费与发 Key 均在 AI21 完成。
